transcript.text: Good morning, it's Vega here! It may be time for your medication. Have you already taken it?

I understand it can be easy to get distracted. Let's focus for a moment on your medication. Do you think you might want to take it now? It’s okay if you haven’t taken it yet; we all forget sometimes.
I wasn't able to confirm whether you've taken today's medication, so I'll let your caregiver know to check in with you soon.
